business_summary: Wuxi Smart Auto-Control Engineering Co., Ltd. engages in the designs, research, develops, manufactures, and sales of control valves in China. The company offers single-seat valves, ball valves, sleeve valves, corrosion-resistant valves, and butterfly valves. It also provides inspection and maintenance services for control valves. Its products are used in the oil and gas, petrochemical, metallurgical industry, new energy and new materials, power industry, fine chemicals, food and medicine other, and other industries. Wuxi Smart Auto-Control Engineering Co., Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is based in Wuxi, China.
